items.text: a master row in the mixer: overall volume with the live line of everything you hear, and M to mute (the field keeps moving)
each mixer channel shows its sound live, a wave behind its slider; the level's share of the track is tinted
the mixer. A beat, a bytebeat, your music and the microphone each have a channel with a level, mute (M) and solo (S), and can play together
mixer presets: beat only, beat + byte, voice over beat, room, everything
choose the microphone input (a plugged-in performance mic) and voice or raw sound
tapping a beat no longer stops a bytebeat or your music: each sound goes to its own channel; a look's own sound still replaces everything
"mix" moved into the inputs on the sound shelf and opens the mixer
mute on the sound shelf, as in a mixer: the sound keeps playing and the field keeps moving to it, silently; "muted" shows under the speaker
no play/stop on the sound shelf: the speaker on the bar is the one on/off; tap the sound that is playing to stop it
the sound shelf reads inputs first (mic, your music), then the beats and bytebeats, then the settings
the words list sorts by sequence, A to Z, or your own order (drag the handle); the sequence plays in the order shown
"same size": every word in the sequence is set at one size, the one that fits the longest word or line
LOOP, SWIM and PLAY are in the list from the start, ready to play
the add row reads "add word…", with + at its right
on a computer, a pin at the foot of the index: pinned it stays open; unpinned, a click on the stage closes it
the CHAMY·XYZ mark stays at the foot of the index with a close button; the version and copyright open under it at the end of the index, or with a click on the mark
